entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-31
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Decouple tracking of synthesized top-level types from `PrivateImplementationDetails` class #70812
    Backlog
  • RoslynCodeAnalysisService makes full-solution-analysis almost unusable with large projects #61832
  • [Obsolete(error: true)] ignored in code marked `[Obsolete]` #80961
  • 'Diagnostic analyzer runner' crashing #80964
  • Error messages for using a keyword instead of an identifier could be improved #11418
    Backlog
  • 'DocumentationCommentTriviaSyntax.Ancestors(true)' does not return any ancestors but 'AncestorsAndSelf(true)' does #46964
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11130.179 #80968

Updated

  • Smart break line doesn't insert object initializer for implicit object creation #80791
    Backlog
  • Brace completion exception in Code Analysis (Version: 18.3.0 Insiders [11114.75.main]) #80729
    18.3
  • "Move contents to namespace" can crash the IDE when namespace is extremely long #80774
    18.3
  • IDE0058 and null propagation - Inconsistent, request fix. #80766
    18.3
  • Performance regression when running analyzers with .NET 10 #80756
    18.3
  • Restore.cmd does not complete #80644
    18.3

Created

  • Removing unused related document code #80973
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add a script for starting the PR validation pipeline #80971
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add SDK analyzer assembly redirector #80969

  • Limit MaxDegreeOfParallelism in RoslynParallel #80963
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next

    VSCode, Next
  • Decouple tracking of synthesized top-level types from PrivateImplementationDetails class #80970
    Area-Compilers, Next

    VSCode, Next
  • Add narrator support to pick member search bar #80966
    Area-IDE, UX Review Not Required, Next
  • Add snap script #80591
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Improve error messages for keywords used as identifiers in LINQ let clauses #80695
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix SyntaxNode.Ancestors() to work correctly with structured trivia #80786
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Fix IsSymbolAccessibleWithin to respect EmbeddedAttribute #80681
  • Implement canonical miscellaneous files project loader for non-file-based programs #80748
    VSCode
  • Remove MSBuild dependencies from BuidlHost deps.json #80959
    VSCode
  • Remove MSBuild dependencies from BuidlHost deps.json #80957
  • Consider PATH again when searching for dotnet host #80859
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix Color Color const field initialization accessing the Color type #68283
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged, Backlog
  • Enable LSP go-to-definition, find-all-references, and go-to-implementation with command handler precedence #80951
  • Fix returning valid pp symbol info on unrelated preprocessor directives #72910

  • Fix build task custom compiler logic #80948
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve arity error message to prefer generic type when both generic and non-generic exist #80707
